fields.name: Direction
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x428F3D0 (per-frame nudge update; component fetched by its getter bg3.exe+0x7070F0) stores the two 4-byte halves of the input direction (FUN_14428EED0 result) at +0/+4; Windows bg3.exe+0x428F5F0 copies these 8 bytes into eoc::controller::NudgeOneFrameComponent, whose SE declaration (Coverage.h) is glm::vec2 Direction (read as floats by ecl::PickingHelper::NudgeSelection). macOS ctor 0.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x428F3D0 (per-frame nudge update; component fetched by its getter bg3.exe+0x7070F0): byte flag tested before the direction is updated and cleared when the hold time passes the threshold; Windows bg3.exe+0x428F5F0 creates the NudgeOneFrame only when it is set. macOS ctor stores 1.

fields.name: _Pad9
fields.evidence: padding (the next member is a 4-byte float)

fields.name: ElapsedTime
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x428F3D0 (per-frame nudge update; component fetched by its getter bg3.exe+0x7070F0): accumulates the frame time (param_2 +8) and is compared with ls::GlobalSwitches +0xE6C (a hold threshold); reset to 0 when the input drops by < 0.2. | Name: Per-frame nudge update bg3.exe+0x428F3D0 adds the frame time (GameTime +8) to it and compares it with a threshold.

fields.name: LastInputMagnitude
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x428F3D0 (per-frame nudge update; component fetched by its getter bg3.exe+0x7070F0): the last input magnitude; compared with the current one (within 0.01) and replaced together with Direction. | Name: Same function: the previous frame's input magnitude, compared with the current one.

fields.name: HoldTime
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x428F3D0 (per-frame nudge update; component fetched by its getter bg3.exe+0x7070F0): set to 0 when the threshold is reached, then accumulates the frame time while the input stays below 0.1. | Name: Same function: reset to 0 when the threshold is reached, then accumulates the frame time while the input is held.

fields.name: HoldThresholdReached
fields.evidence: Windows bg3.exe+0x428F3D0 (per-frame nudge update; component fetched by its getter bg3.exe+0x7070F0): byte flag set to 1 when the hold threshold is reached (selects the cooldown branch), cleared when the target is lost. | Name: Same function: set to 1 when the hold threshold is reached.
